text:
DeployBot: Canary deploy of prompt-router v2 -> prod/eu-west triggered at 2026-03-15T13:17:56Z. Monitoring alerts enabled.
Sasha: seeing spike in 502/504s from prompt-router-v2 canary (eu-west-1). ~12% error rate on sampled traffic.
Alicia (oncall): paging oncall. @mike you're up next? :rotating_light:
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-20260315-78 - prompt-router v2 canary errors. Pager duty => Alicia.
Mike: on it. giving quick status. do we have a customer-facing impact metric?
Sasha: quick sample from Grafana: 
```
metric: prompt_router.v2.response_code.count{region="eu-west-1"}
window: last_5m
5xx_rate: 12.3% -> baseline 0.4%
p50 latency: 140ms -> baseline 95ms
p95 latency: 820ms -> baseline 260ms
```
Sasha: errors start ~13:12Z and rose during canary ramp. stack traces show timeouts to backend "kv-cache" and occasional NPE.
Jordan: I can run a canary abort and flip routing at infra layer. confirmation to proceed?
Mike: yes. priority is stop user impact. if we can flip traffic away from v2 to v1 fallback, do that first so no full rollback.
Ben (infra): I can route 100% of canary traffic back to prompt-router-v1 for eu-west via routing-policy FF. PR ready: `featureflag.routing.prompt_router_v2.euwest` -> off.
Mike: Alicia, handoff to you for FF flip and customer comms. I'm going to collect logs and coordinate with Sasha for a post-mortem.
Alicia (oncall): taking it. executing emergency toggle now.
Alicia (oncall): running command: 
```
# toggle feature flag to disable v2 routing in eu-west
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $K8S_TOKEN" \
  https://flags.internal.redwood/v1/toggle \
  -d '{"flag":"prompt_router_v2.euwest","state":"off","actor":"oncall"}'
```
Alicia (oncall): response: 200 OK, flag set to OFF.
DeployBot: Routing update broadcast: prompt-router-v2 traffic fraction in eu-west set to 0% (fallback to v1).
Emily (support): support queue: multiple customers reported 5xx on prompt generation, top ticket from AcmeCorp. I posted a temporary note: "We're investigating degraded responses for EU customers; mitigation in progress."
Mike: can we confirm impact delta? Sasha, re-run sampling.
Sasha: sampling after toggle: 
```
window: 13:25-13:30Z
5xx_rate eu-west: 0.6% (back to baseline)
p95 eu-west: 270ms
```
Sasha: looks like routing flip mitigated most errors. some residual errors from legacy requests during handoff but trending down.
Ben (infra): I also started a targeted canary abort job for the deployment in eu-west so no further v2 pods will be promoted.
Jordan: requesting rollback of the canary artifact from the deployment pipeline to prevent accidental re-promote. I filed a rollback job: roll/ci/3245 abort.
Alicia (oncall): updating incident: mitigation applied (emergency toggle + abort). Customer impact: roughly 6-8% of EU traffic for ~13 minutes, peak affected customers ~45 orgs, high-severity for 3 customers (AcmeCorp, SignalFlow, Nimbus).
Emily (support): I've sent proactive emails to the 3 high-severity customers. copies in #support-private.
Mike: good. action items: 1) keep FF off for eu-west 2) collect root cause logs from kv-cache & v2 pods 3) schedule rollback verification 4) postmortem owner? Sasha and Jordan to co-author.
Sasha: I'll take root cause + logs. initial hypothesis: regression in handling of stale KV cache pointers plus missing nil-check causing cascaded timeouts.
Jordan: I'll own rollout gating and CI checks to ensure we add a smoke test that exercises kv-cache latencies.
Ben (infra): I'll keep the routing policy pinned and add an automated rollback on similar error-surge thresholds for future canaries.
Alicia (oncall): final note: feature flag kill toggle performed (internal term: emergency-toggle) at 13:21Z. Incident status -> mitigated. Will remain monitored for 30m.
incident-bot: Updated incident INC-20260315-78 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Assigned: Sasha, Jordan.
Emily (support): closing related support tickets as "mitigated", leaving notes for follow-up postmortem.
Mike: thanks all. quick retro in #eng-runtime later today. assign postmortem within 48h.
Sasha: adding logs dump link: https://logs.redwood/internal/archives/2026-03-15/prompt-router-v2-euwest.tar.gz (sensitive)
Jordan: also captured CI artifact id: prompt-router:v2@sha256:9abc... saved.
Alicia (oncall): handing back to oncall rotation. I'll drop a short timeline in the incident doc. :white_check_mark:
DeployBot: Incident INC-20260315-78 closed (status: monitoring) at 13:27Z by Alicia.
Mike: follow-up: add a canary rollback playbook tweak to include immediate FF fallback as first step.
Sasha: agreed. will include code snippets and runbooks.
Ben (infra): tagging platform ops to add a safety circuit that can auto-flip routing for severe spikes.
Alicia (oncall): closing thread. thanks everyone.
